07-1.title: Where cost concentrates
07-1.tldr: Embedding is a one-time, change-only indexing cost; the recurring traffic-scaling cost is generation, especially input tokens from long context. Optimize generation.
points: Input tokens dominate with long context.

07-2.title: Reducing cost in high-volume RAG
07-2.tldr: Cut the dominant input-token/generation cost: rerank a larger candidate set down to a smaller k, cache (exact and semantic), route easy queries to smaller models, shorten prompts/context, and summarize history.
points: Rerank down to a smaller k.
Route easy queries to smaller models.

07-3.title: Controlling unpredictable cost
07-3.tldr: Bound the loop (iterations/rounds/time), cap tokens per request and session, let cheap models do cheap work, cache, offload/summarize context, and surface per-run cost to budget and alert.

07-4.title: First cut: 50% cost reduction
07-4.tldr: Cheapest high-impact cuts: route easy queries to a smaller model, lower top-k, cache, shorten the prompt, and reduce the agent's iteration cap.
points: Route easy queries to a smaller model.

07-5.title: Designing caching
07-5.tldr: Layer caches: exact-match response/prompt cache, provider prefix/prompt caching, an embedding cache, and a semantic cache that embeds the query and returns a prior answer above a similarity threshold.
points: Semantic cache with a similarity threshold.

07-6.title: Reducing latency
07-6.tldr: Stream tokens so time-to-first-token matters more than total; parallelize independent steps; cache prompts/embeddings; route easy steps to faster models; don't block the event loop.
points: Route easy steps to faster models.

07-7.title: Threads vs processes for I/O-bound LLM calls
07-7.tldr: For I/O-bound calls, async or threads beat multiprocessing: the CPU is idle while waiting, so you want concurrency, not extra processes. Async is the most efficient.

07-8.title: Architecture at 10x traffic
07-8.tldr: You hit dependencies and queues before arithmetic: provider rate limits and 429s, serialized tool/DB access, memory pressure from context, and connection pools. Cost scales with tokens.
